QuestInfo.name: Stirge Phobia
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p417#, who works at the subway entrance in #m10003000#, has something on his mind.
QuestInfo.1: It seems like #p417#, who works at the subway entrance in #m10003000#, needs #p404#'s help to cure his fear of #o17#. I should ask #b#p404##k in #b#m10003000##k if there is a good way. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I went to see #p404# to help cure the fear of #o17# that #p417#, who works at the subway entrance in #m10003000#, is suffering from.

0.0: The city assigned me to manage the subway entrance, and I quite enjoy the work, but to be completely honest, I get anxious sometimes. Since you're a fellow neighbor living in this city, I feel I can tell you... I'm terrified of #o17#s. And working here, you never know when those things might pop out...
0.1: You ask why I'm so afraid of #o17#s? Well, it's a bit embarrassing, but... when I was little, #p404# and I went exploring the subway down there to test our courage. I didn't realize he had already gone back home and kept holding out inside until I got lost, only to be rescued the next day. That night, the #o17#s flying all around me were so horrifying... I think it all started back then.
0.2: But I can't just keep being afraid forever. Come to think of it, I believe #b#p404##k once mentioned a #bmedicine that could help overcome a phobia of #o17#s#k. Could you perhaps go to him and ask about that medicine?

yes.0: Thank you! You should be able to find #p404# in #m10003000#. I'll be waiting right here!

no.0: It would be so nice if neighbors could help each other out...

1.0: What is it? Come to think of it, you look like a resident of this city... What? #p417# is asking about a medicine to cure his phobia of #o17#? I see...

npc.0: Please go to #p404# in #m10003000# and ask him about the medicine to cure a phobia of #o17#. I'll be waiting right here!
